apps.name: Fathom
apps.subtitle: A read-only teal.fm dashboard
apps.localizedDescription:
Fathom is a native dashboard for the plays already in your AT Protocol repository.

Now — what is playing, today's plays and time, your current streak, a fourteen-day chart and recent plays.

Stats — plays, time, artists, releases and tracks for 7 days, 30 days or all time, with the busiest day and most used service.

History — every play, grouped by the day you actually had it, with search and a month jump.

Profile — your teal.fm profile, DID and a plain statement of where the figures come from.

Fathom is read-only. It has no account, no password and no token. It reads public records directly from your PDS, never through a Fathom backend, and saves the last read on your device so the next launch opens immediately.

AltStore Classic signs this unsigned IPA with your own Apple ID when it installs it.
